messages.subject: Error in validObject(.Object) :    invalid class "ngCMatrix" object:  slot i is not *strictly* increasing inside a column
parts:
Does anyone know how to solve this problem

I open a two column .csv file which is sorted on both cols. The format
is:

order_num items
1 item1
1 item 2
1 item 3 ... ect
2
2

But when I run association analysis with baskets I get the error

Error in validObject(.Object) :
invalid class "ngCMatrix" object: slot i is not *strictly*
increasing inside a column


many thanks

Ross

I've not been able to repeat this error yet. What version of Rattle
and what version R and arules?

> packageDescription("rattle", field="Version")
> packageDescription("arules", field="Version")
> version

Also, do you get the same error with the sample basket dataset?

> rattle(system.file("csv", "dvdtrans.csv", package="rattle"))
Select Item as Target variable, then click Execute
Click Associate tab, click Basket check button, click Execute

That works for me.

Regards,
Graham

For the public record: we resolved the issue offline.

The problem was that the baskets contained repeated items. If we
remove the repeated items it works.

I'll capture this error in Rattle so that it will pop up a message
when this happens and provide the suggestion to remove the repeated
items.

Thanks to Ross for reporting the problem and helping resolve it.

Regards,
Graham

messages.author: 51ea28fc190ac537
messages.subject: Re: error in reading CSV file
parts:
Hi Jüri,

This is probably an issue with locale. A work around might be:

> ds <- read.csv(system.file("csv", "weather.csv", package="rattle"))

That might load the dataset without trying to use UTF-8 encoding.

Then in Rattle on the Data tab choose the R Dataset option and under
the Data Name drop down box choose "ds", then Execute

Let me know how you go.

Regards,
Graham
